info.title: Yijie Events
info.description: Event contracts exchanged by Yijie services.

agentSessionEvents.description: Sanitized Agent Host events. Consumers order and resume events by stream_id plus sequence and deduplicate at-least-once delivery by event_id.

agentSessionEventsV2.description: Explicitly negotiated v2 Agent Host events. This stream preserves v1 lifecycle events and adds bounded raw-reasoning text delta/finalized variants.

receiveAgentSessionEvents.description: Receive one AgentSessionEvent at a time. A stream_id change starts a new ordering domain; it does not imply replay of events from an earlier Host process.

receiveAgentSessionEventsV2.description: Receive one AgentSessionEventV2 at a time after explicit schema-version-2 negotiation. A stream_id change starts a new ordering domain. Delivery is at least once and consumers deduplicate by event_id.

AgentSessionEvent.name: AgentSessionEvent
AgentSessionEvent.title: Ordered Agent Host session event
AgentSessionEvent.summary: At-least-once event ordered by sequence within a single stream_id.
AgentSessionEvent.description: JSON payload semantics are authoritative in the referenced JSON Schema. Protobuf message yijie.events.v1.AgentSessionEvent carries the equivalent service and asynchronous-consumer model.

correlationId.description: Agent Host session that owns the ordered event stream.

AgentSessionEventV2.name: AgentSessionEventV2
AgentSessionEventV2.title: Ordered Agent Host session event v2
AgentSessionEventV2.summary: V1 lifecycle plus bounded raw-reasoning text events.
AgentSessionEventV2.description: JSON payload semantics are authoritative in the referenced JSON Schema. Protobuf message yijie.events.v2.AgentSessionEvent carries the equivalent service and asynchronous-consumer model. Producers emit v2 only after the consumer explicitly negotiates schema version 2.

correlationId.description: Agent Host session that owns the ordered event stream.

session-event.schema.title: AgentSessionEvent
session-event.schema.description: A sanitized Agent Host event. The event_type discriminator selects one payload, correlation-ID, and terminal-state variant. Sequence is monotonic only within one stream_id. A new Host process creates a new stream_id and does not replay content from an earlier process.

session-event-v2.schema.title: AgentSessionEventV2
session-event-v2.schema.description: A sanitized Agent Host event negotiated through the v2 stream. It preserves v1 lifecycle semantics and adds bounded raw-reasoning text projection. Sequence is monotonic only within one stream_id and delivery is at least once.
